question: At a certain beach if it is at least \(80^{\circ} F\) and sunny, then the beach will be crowded. On June \(10\) the beach was not crowded. What can be concluded about the weather conditions on June \(10?\)
solution:
If June \(10\) had been both at least \(80^\circ\mathrm{F}\) and sunny, the given rule would force the beach to be crowded. This contradicts the information that it was not crowded. Therefore at least one of those weather conditions failed: the temperature was cooler than \(80^\circ\mathrm{F}\), or it was not sunny.

Here “or” allows both conditions to fail. The information does not tell us which one failed or require both to fail. The conclusion is choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
